entities.summary: Bedok Lighthouse is an automated lighthouse in Bedok, Singapore. First announced in March 1978, Bedok Lighthouse commenced operations on 9 August 1978 to replace the Fullerton Lighthouse. Initially operated by the Port of Singapore Authority (PSA), the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) took over operations of the lighthouse in February 1996. Bedok Lighthouse is located on top of a residential building 76 metres (249 ft) above sea level.
